_description: Stage 1: architecture sensitivity grid. H = hidden_size, L = num_layers. Trained from scratch for both datasets, at each dataset's existing baseline history duration, under 3 seeds each.
note_dropout_single_layer: torch.nn.GRU only applies inter-layer dropout when num_layers > 1; VIV_GRU (src/viv_analysis/models/gru.py) already passes dropout=0.0 whenever num_layers==1, so every L=1 architecture in this grid trains with dropout inactive regardless of the 'dropout':0.1 fixed value above.
